_comment: RED ON PURPOSE since plan_demo_steps@v11 (2026-08-20). Category (c): the expectation
states a target v11 deliberately no longer aims at. The regress harness ignores this key
(fixtureSchema strips what it does not name).
expected.sourceIndexes pins 12, the routing dialog with the destination chosen. v11's
one-beat test merges that dialog's whole run: states 11/12 share 4 of the longer array's
9 entries (44%) and 12/13 share 3 of 7 exactly — 4 of 7 once the OCR drift between
'(1) אישר ניתוב' and '(1) אישור ניתוב' is counted as shared, which v11 tells the model to
do. Both are over the one-third threshold, so 11-12-13 collapse to ONE beat, and the rule
says keep the LATER state. That is 13, not 12. Nothing else about the expectation moved.
Re-pin 12 -> 13 only after a run shows the model actually getting there. The 2026-08-20
v11 run did not: it captioned state 11 at six words inside a 1600ms window and came out
10000ms long, i.e. it never applied the merge that would have removed the pair.
That failure is NOT the arithmetic bug v11 fixed, and it would have failed identically under
v10: the 11->12 gap is exactly 1600ms, where v10's broken first row and readTimeMs agree, and
v10 capped that band at three words too — it never licensed six. v10's row was wrong only
for gaps in [1400, 1600). What went wrong here is the model not applying a rule the prompt
states correctly, which no table can fix.
